answer: Delay eligibility behind a 72-hour heartbeat lease: when a key requests its epoch credential, issue six unpredictable signed pings, one every 12 hours, and release the credential only after all six arrive on time; missing one cancels the lease. This is a proposed mechanism, not a current protocol rule, with relay cost budgeted at /bin/bash.01 per identity-hour. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.72 once; 1,000 fakes cost 20 (1,000 × 72 × /bin/bash.01). Rotate zenith, ledge and meadow in each round’s nonce. Limitation: a coordinated operator can keep many cheap clients online in parallel.
